description: This is an Android activity class named BusinessCardActivity that manages user interaction for selecting a contact and displaying the contact's name and phone number. It includes UI setup, handling contact picker invocation, and asynchronous loading of contact data.

classes.name: BusinessCardActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that facilitates picking a contact and displaying its name and phone number.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets up the click listener for the 'Pick Contact' button.

methods.name: pickContact
methods.description: Starts the contact picker activity via an intent.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the contact picker activity; retrieves contact data URI if successful.

methods.name: loadContactInfo
methods.description: Starts an AsyncTask to load contact data in the background.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Updates UI elements with contact's display name and phone number.
